message: Tally is a no-code form builder a Customer Success or Ops person can use to build a structured customer request/feedback form and pass submissions into the tools their team already works in. A licensed product bridge exists only for the qualified slice. Draft only around the addressed needs and the dossier's scope limits. No companies have been qualified; verify recipient fit before outreach.
